headline: Apple is hiring engineers to build its own AI agent
summary: Apple is actively recruiting engineers to develop its own AI agent. This agent will handle tasks like web browsing, app interaction, and coding. The move signifies Apple's intensified focus on agentic AI technology.

headline: A brief history of Nvidia’s recent stock fluctuations
summary: Nvidia's stock price plummeted by nearly 40% after its third-quarter earnings call. The share price dropped to around $150, erasing a brief post-earnings surge. This significant fluctuation impacts the embattled chip company's market valuation.

headline: Meta now sells 3D movies on Quest VR headsets
summary: Meta has launched over 150 3D movies for purchase or rent on Quest 3 and 3S VR headsets. Titles include blockbusters like Avatar and Spider-Man: Far From Home. Users can access these films directly through Meta's TV app in VR.

headline: Meta’s Muse Charm might cost $300
summary: Meta's upcoming Muse Charm gadget, designed for AI interaction, is rumored to cost $300. This device features a screen for chatting with the Muse AI agent. CEO Mark Zuckerberg hinted at a holiday release for the product.

headline: Lanterns Star Aaron Pierre Addresses His DCU Future: 'What Will Be Will Be'
summary: Aaron Pierre addressed his uncertain future as Green Lantern John Stewart in the DCU. His role in 'Man of Tomorrow' is in question following changes in DC Studios leadership. Pierre expressed a sense of peace regarding the potential outcome.

headline: Alienware's OLED Gaming Monitors Drop to New Price Lows for Black Friday, Starting From Just $280
summary: Alienware OLED gaming monitors are now available at their lowest prices ever for Black Friday. Deals start from an affordable $280, offering significant savings. This is an ideal opportunity to upgrade your gaming setup with high-end displays.

headline: GTA 6 Has Police Departments Across America Begging People Not to Commit Crimes IRL
summary: The massive popularity of GTA 6 has led US police departments to issue warnings against real-life crime. Law enforcement agencies are urging citizens not to imitate in-game criminal acts. The game's hype is creating unexpected public safety concerns.

headline: Today’s Best Deals: Forza 6 Xbox Controller, Resident Evil Requiem, and a SteamOS Legion Go S
summary: Today's top deals include a Forza 6 Xbox Controller and the game Resident Evil Requiem. Shoppers can also find savings on a SteamOS Legion Go S. Additional discounts are available on a Samsung Switch 2 microSD card and Sony WH-1000XM5 headphones.

headline: Woman drugged and advertised for sex by husband speaks out as abusers found guilty
summary: Joanne Young bravely spoke out after her husband drugged and exploited her for sex over 13 years. She stated the ordeal 'cost me my life as I knew it.' Her abusers have now been found guilty, bringing some closure.

headline: Tens of thousands of UK fridges secured from hackers in secret nationwide operation
summary: A secret nationwide operation secured tens of thousands of UK fridges from potential hackers. Supermarkets, warehouses, and restaurants urgently patched their devices. This proactive measure prevented widespread cyber-attacks on critical infrastructure.

headline: Anthropic becomes one of world's most valuable public companies in stock market debut
summary: Anthropic made a highly successful stock market debut, achieving a valuation as one of the world's most valuable public companies. It is the first purely AI-focused company to go public. Its performance will serve as a crucial benchmark for the entire AI industry.

headline: Bowen: Myanmar genocide verdict is historic and could have far-reaching implications
summary: The Myanmar genocide verdict is hailed as historic, with potentially significant global implications. Lawyers will meticulously study how Gambia successfully proved Myanmar's genocidal intent. This landmark case could set precedents in international law and human rights.
